label: verify-6-feasibility
rule: R7 Wait-and-confirm: after an R1 trigger wait 5 minutes and buy only if the bet is still listed with EV still at least 2.5% (NO GAIN)
reason: Fails on feasibility and on what it can honestly claim. (1) It is not a setting: AutoBettor.run is stateless per cycle (its only memory is the refusal cooldown map), so R7 is a new feature (a first-passed time per bet, a hold, a ScanSettings/PresetRules field, tests). (2) The 77 'confirmed' bets are not bets the app can place: re-judged with the auto-bet's own criteria at the confirm moment only 24 of 77 (31%) pass (18 are not in the app's own CNO list at that time, only the study's wide read or the Vigilant scan lists them; 11 have no book check; 9 have under 3 books agreeing; 5 a book check older than 5 min; 4 odds outside -200/+130; 2 vetoed ...). So the builder's 34 bets a day is about 10.6 a day on the app's machinery, and at the app's real volume (about 28 CNO auto-bets a day) R7 would cut it by about 63%: only 23 of the 63 auto-bets matched to the study (58 CNO, 5 Vigilant scan) were still listed with EV >= 2.5% 5 minutes after it bought them. (3) No cap binds (idealised R7 uses 12% of the $500 day, app-feasible 4%; biggest game $26.74 of $70), so every dropped bet is forgone edge: expected CLV dollars a day fall from about $3.66 to $1.76 (idealised) and from $1.63 to $0.78 (app-feasible); the 107 bets R7 drops still beat the close by +2.36% on 64 closes. (4) The gain cannot be evaluated cleanly: 25 of 77 (32%) have no close (24 props, 22 never placed); of the 52 closes 38 are Tracker closes (the app's own CNO-books read near the start, 63 of the 75 Tracker closes across R1 are labelled CNO's books: the same source as the EV the rule confirms) at +4.14%, and the 14 independent closes (Novig trades, Pinnacle) are -0.35% [-1.51,+1.13] against +1.43% on 27 for the unconfirmed: gap -1.78 pts [-3.69,-0.03]. Confirmed has 73% Tracker closes against 58% for unconfirmed: adjusted for close source the gap is -0.07 pt [-2.12,+1.31]. The raw gap is +0.41 pt [-1.59,+1.83], p(<=0) 0.37. (5) It does not loosen any safety limit (it is a pure tightening) and uses no look-ahead or closing line, which is why the verdict rests on points 1-4, not on safety.
numbers_reproduced: Re-implemented from the expr with the shared loader (own code). R1: 184 bets, 44 games, 116 closes/40 games, CLV +2.54% [+1.77,+3.52]. R7 after 5 min: 53 not listed by any source, 18 with under 2 minutes to the start at T, 36 listed under 2.5%, 77 confirmed (the builder splits the same 71 as 55 dropped + 16 past start; total identical). Confirmed: 77 bets, 28 games, 52 closes/25 games, CLV +2.93% [+1.92,+3.79] (builder 0.029316, CI +1.99..+3.81: identical point value; my CI differs by the bootstrap draw), same bets at their trigger price +2.77% (identical to the builder's baseline 0.027686), not confirmed 107 bets/38 games, 64 closes +2.36% [+1.13,+3.99]; raw gap +0.41 pt [-1.59,+1.83], p(<=0) 0.37 (builder +0.41 [-1.68,+1.81], 0.36). Per day 34.1 (77 over 2.256 study days). Halves: builder-style split by decision day (Oct 3 | Oct 4+) +2.32% on 9 closes/7 games | +3.06% on 43 closes/18 games (identical to the builder); the loader's date split (cut Oct 4) H1 58 bets/25 games/46 closes +2.80% [+1.74,+3.73], H2 19 bets/4 games/6 closes/3 games +3.95% (3 games: carries no weight); confirmed minus not-confirmed is +0.5 pt in H1 and +0.6 pt in H2 (6 vs 12 closes). Luck: random 77-of-184 subsets reach +2.77% with p 0.29 (+2.93% p 0.18), within-game label shuffle p 0.11. All match the builder; the rule reproduces and shows no gain.

machinery.needed_change: new state in app/.../AutoBettor.kt run() (the judge loop near lines 172-181; the only memory today is `cooldown`, line 125, for refused bets): a first-passed time per CnoRow.key, skip while now - first < 5 min, drop the key when a cycle no longer passes, then re-judge at the live Novig price with PRICE_TOLERANCE as today; plus a ScanSettings field, PresetRules and Presets summary, migration, tests. data/.../AutoBet.judge() is pure and has no time dimension.
machinery.book_check_gate: AutoScan.kt AUTO_BET_CHECK_TOP = 10 (line 473): only the 10 best candidates get a book page read, re-read after 4 min; a read older than Freshness.MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS (5 min) drops the bet from cnoChecked. A held bet that falls out of the top 10 during the wait cannot pass.
machinery.wide_read_is_study_only: CnoFeed.readWide is called only from StudySync.kt (line 44): 'Never shown in the app'. The app's auto-bet reads the CNO list under Tj's filters plus Novig's live price plus the book check.
machinery.min_lead: the app's MIN_LEAD_MS is 60 s (AutoBettor.kt line 711); the rule used 2 min
machinery.limits_loosened: none: R7 only adds a condition; judge(), PRICE_TOLERANCE 0.03, pregame only, MAX_PER_CYCLE 5, per-day $500, per-game $70, halt on a lost order, sharp veto, trap guard all stay. Safe only if it buys at the live price at confirm time, never at the earlier price.

idealised_R7_vs_R1.stake_rule: 1/4 Kelly on the bankroll setting at the look's price and CNO fair, capped at $3.50 a bet and at the dollars available at the price

app_feasible_variant_first_app_eligible_.definition: first moment the bet is in the app's CNO list with EV 2.5-15%, a book check no older than 5 min with 2+ books two-sided, 3+ agreeing, no sharp veto, kind prop/moneyline/spread, odds -200..+130, 1 min..6 h to the start; R7 = still passing 5 min later
app_feasible_variant_first_app_eligible_.why_not_credible: 20 of 24 confirmed closes are Tracker closes (CNO's own books near the start); the 4 independent closes are +0.18% against +0.51% on 8; the bets the app really placed show the opposite sign (below); 522 variants were tried.

what_actually_happened_to_placed_bets.reading: opposite signs in auto and hand-placed bets; the pooled gap is noise

closes.tracker_close_is: the app's own re-read of CNO's books before the start for a bet Tj/auto also placed (63 of the 75 Tracker closes across R1 say CNO's books): not independent of the CNO EV the rule confirms

caveats: Every number is from about 2.26 days of first-looks; the second date half of R7 is 4 games (3 with closes) and carries no weight.

My app-eligibility replay (app_ok) approximates the auto-bet's judge() from the study's looks (list look, book-check look, kind, odds, EV band, 6 h window); it is validated by volume (62 eligible triggers = 27.5 a day against 27.9 a day for the 63 CNO auto-bets actually placed since the study began) but not by bet-for-bet identity: 48 of the 62 were placed by Tj or the auto-bet.

The app-feasible variant shows a +1.09 pt gap (p 0.08, CI -0.40..+2.28) in R7's favour. It is not corroborated: 20 of 24 closes are Tracker closes, 4 independent closes show +0.18% vs +0.51%, and the real auto-bets show -1.05 pts. With 522 variants tried it is a candidate for a shadow test, not a rule.

The 5-minute placement check on real bets uses the study's looks (a look at least every 5 minutes while listed), so 'still listed' is known to within a few minutes; 21 of 53 'dropped' bets reappear later, so the list state is noisy (CNO's 100-row limit, read gaps).

Stakes use 1/4 Kelly at the look's price and CNO's fair, capped at $3.50 and at the dollars available; the real auto-bet also applies the sharp veto's fair and per-game exposure, so real stakes can only be smaller.
Independent closes are 14 (11 games) for R7 and 41 for R1: too few to call the -1.78 pt gap real; it says only that the confirmation signal has no independent support.

Proposal for Tj, not an action: if he wants the persistence idea tested, log a 'would have confirmed at +5 min' flag in the study (the looks already carry it) and revisit with about 180 independent closes per arm (about 20 days at the current pace); do not build the hold into the auto-bet now.
